recentPosts.text:
Happy Labour Day to every worker across New Zealand, and especially to the security professionals who help keep people, property, and communities safe.
Our work is essential, and many in the security industry will not have the luxury of taking the day off.
While others rest, travel, and spend time with loved ones, security stand ready for the next job.
Today, we want to acknowledge and thank all Red Wolf Security employees, as well as our colleagues here in New Zealand and in Australia at ADT Security Australia, ADT Security New Zealand , Wormald NZ , ACG Integration - (Australia), Signature Security Group, Intelligent Monitoring Solutions and Intelligent Monitoring Group Limited – along with security professionals and workers around the world.
Your commitment, professionalism, and hard work do not go unnoticed.
If you are fortunate enough to have the day off, we hope you enjoy it with your whānau.
#LabourDay #SecurityProfessionals #ProtectingWhatMatters #KeepingCommunitiesSafe #Essent

It's been just over a month since R. was awarded Security Consultant of the Year at the New Zealand Security Association, and we're still proud of what this achievement represents.
Combined with Shamal Kumar's recognition as a finalist, it highlights the depth of talent across the Red Wolf team and our commitment to delivering great outcomes for our clients.
Thanks NZSA, Gary Morrison, Lucy Nichols, Tacia Strawbridge, and everyone else involved in making this incredible event possible.
Well done again, team.
#NZSA #SecurityAwards #TeamRedWolf #SecurityConsultant #NewZealand #RedWolfHighLevelSecurity
